comm_messages.speaker: Buyer
comm_messages.message:
Buyer sends a friendly and positive message to the seller: 

"Hi there! I'm really interested in that coffee mug you have. It seems like a great item, and I believe it could be a wonderful addition to my collection. I'm looking forward to negotiating a fair price that works for both of us. Let’s make this a win-win!"

comm_messages.speaker: Seller
comm_messages.message: Seller Hello! I'm excited to discuss the coffee mug with you. It's a unique piece, and I'm sure it will make a great addition to your collection. I believe it offers good value, and I’m looking forward to finding a price that works for both of us. Let’s make this happen!
